Razor's innate movespeed bonus is weird, but that means his powerspike item is also weird. It's Boots of Travel that makes him runs at 534 ms. Razor suffers from Silver Edge because of the movespeed cap, not the break for Forked Lightning passive.

Thats why you need to ward Razor to make sure his ult is used to flash farm item instead of ganking. One less skill for him to hit you while running. If you have 2 Blademail gankers like Pudge or Legion Commander, Razor would kill himself constantly.

comments.text:
As a Razor main, I avoid picking Razor against Eye of Skadi and Linken core heroes and Outworld Devourer.

My favourite hero to bully with Razor is Sniper and melee heroes that isnt Bloodseeker. I hate Brewmaster, Meepo, Visage, and Juggernaut because his cast point for Omnislash is shorter than Razor's Static Link. I hate laning against Venomancer and Silencer because DoTs and Plague Ward doesnt get damaged by Plasma Field and Forked Lightning.

Razor will always be that weird hero which depending on his first item, whether its Aghs, Shard, Mekansm, Orchid, Yasha or BKB can still screw you over.

Therefore counter Razor's items first because Razor is the weakest at level 13-16 as I often polarize his build to the point it makes or break games.

Always hit Razor when his ult is down and make sure he doesnt buy shard or Silver Edge to hard counter anyone without force staff.
comments.author: @defaulted9485
